note: Which CIP 2020 codes get a study plan. DreamCo judgment, written by Grok-Edu-Career-Pathways (AI), not human-reviewed. The crosswalk does not record award level, so bachelor's level is approximated by these exclusions; every excluded code and its reason is listed in data/coverage.csv.
include_rule: Every 6-digit CIP 2020 code (NN.NNNN) in Education_CIP_to_ONET_SOC.xlsx that has at least one crosswalk link to an O*NET 31.0 occupation with a Job Zone 4 or 5 rating, minus the exclusions below. The 27 authored majors are always included.

exclude_series.12: Culinary, personal and entertainment services: certificate and associate programs (cosmetology, culinary arts, etc.).
exclude_series.28: Military science and ROTC: commissioning programs taken alongside a degree, not a bachelor's major.
exclude_series.29: Military technologies: military training programs, not civilian bachelor's majors.
exclude_series.32: Basic skills and developmental/remedial education: non-degree.
exclude_series.34: Health-related knowledge and skills: non-degree personal programs.
exclude_series.46: Construction trades: apprenticeship and certificate programs.
exclude_series.47: Mechanic and repair technologies: trade and certificate programs.
exclude_series.48: Precision production: trade and certificate programs.
exclude_series.49: Transportation and materials moving: pilot, driver and operator training programs.
exclude_series.53: High school/secondary diplomas and certificates: not postsecondary.
exclude_series.60: Health professions residency/fellowship programs: post-degree clinical training.

exclude_prefixes.51.39: Practical/vocational nursing and nursing assistant programs: certificate level.
exclude_prefixes.22.01: Law (J.D.): graduate professional degree, entered after a bachelor's.
exclude_prefixes.22.02: Advanced legal research and LL.M.-type programs: post-J.D.
exclude_prefixes.51.0204: Audiology and speech-language pathology: entry requires a master's or Au.D.
exclude_prefixes.51.05: Advanced/graduate dentistry and dental specialties: post-D.D.S.
exclude_prefixes.51.0912: Physician assistant: entry-level programs are master's degrees.
exclude_prefixes.51.12: Medicine, osteopathic and podiatric medicine (M.D./D.O./D.P.M.): graduate professional degrees.
exclude_prefixes.51.14: Medical clinical sciences and graduate medical studies: graduate programs.
exclude_prefixes.51.2306: Occupational therapy: entry-level programs are master's or doctoral.
exclude_prefixes.51.2308: Physical therapy: entry-level programs are D.P.T. doctorates.
exclude_prefixes.51.20: Pharmacy and pharmaceutical sciences (Pharm.D. and graduate pharmaceutical programs): graduate professional or graduate study.

exclude_title_regex.reason: Technician, assistant/assisting, aide, apprentice and police-academy programs are mostly certificate or associate level. Some codes titled 'Technology/Technician' also cover bachelor's engineering-technology programs; they were excluded conservatively.

authored_exceptions: The 27 authored majors are kept even if a rule above would exclude them. This applies only to 51.2001 Pharmacy (Pharm.D.), an authored major whose plan states the Job Zone 5 graduate route.
exclude_if_no_entry_target: Also excluded: codes whose linked occupations are all Manager, Chief, Postsecondary-faculty or All Other titles (no entry-level target can be named).
